senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָסַר) [to tie up; cmp. חוּב.]

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:13">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מְיַיסֵּר … ביסורין</he> he (the king) punishes the prominent among them (the rebellious citizens); <he>כך הקב״ה מי׳ וכ׳</he> so did the Lord visit Ezekiel in order to wash away the sins of Israel.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:10">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲיַסְּרֵם ביסורין וכ׳</he> I would visit them with afflictions in this world, in order that their arms be strengthened &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3">Ex. R. s. 3</cite>, end <he>המטה שתְּיַיסְּרֶנּוּ בו</he> the staff wherewith to strike him (Pharaoh); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite> <he>היו מִתְיַיסְּרִין בחולי וכ׳</he> used to be visited with bowel diseases for ten days &c. (prior to their death), to indicate that the disease purifies (from sin); <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 3">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. III</cite>. Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ <he>נתיי׳ בבנו הבכור</he> he was punished with the death of his first-born son. Tanḥ. Noah 14 <he>נתי׳ בבנו</he> he was visited with trials through his son (being asked to sacrifice him). Ib. Vayigg. 6 <he>נתי׳ בבנו</he> was tried by his son (Joseph being sold); a. e.
